key: BLDC Current Controller with PWM Generation
title: BLDC Current Controller with PWM Generation
text: 带脉冲宽度调制生成功能的离散时间无刷直流电机电流 PI 控制器，输入 5 路、输出 1 路；按 {Carrier counter} 指定载波计数器模型；{Proportional gain} 控制器比例增益 K p、{Integral gain} 指定积分增益 K i、{Anti-windup gain} 指定抗饱和增益 K aw、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Discretization sample time} 指定离散化采样时间、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零消去、{Timer period (s)} 指定 PWM 定时器周期、{Fundamental sample time (s)} 指定 PWM 生成的采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Proportional gain
params.values: 控制器比例增益 K p 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integral gain
params.values: 积分增益 K i 5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Anti-windup gain
params.values: 抗饱和增益 K aw 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: 离散化采样时间 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Carrier counter
params.values: 载波计数器模型 Up (default) | Down | Up-Down

params.name: Timer period (s)
params.values: PWM 定时器周期 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Fundamental sample time (s)
params.values: PWM 生成的采样时间 0.0001 (default) | positive scalar
